t: Why he fasted so much in a month nobody notices
a: ذَلِكَ شَهْرٌ يَغْفُلُ النَّاسُ عَنْهُ بَيْنَ رَجَبٍ وَرَمَضَانَ وَهُوَ شَهْرٌ تُرْفَعُ فِيهِ الأَعْمَالُ إِلَى رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ فَأُحِبُّ أَنْ يُرْفَعَ عَمَلِي وَأَنَا صَائِمٌ
p: Dhālika shahrun yaghfulu-n-nāsu ʿanhu bayna rajabin wa ramaḍān, wa huwa shahrun turfaʿu fīhi-l-aʿmālu ilā rabbi-l-ʿālamīn, fa-uḥibbu an yurfaʿa ʿamalī wa anā ṣāʾim
m: That is a month people overlook, between Rajab and Ramadan. It is a month in which deeds are raised to the Lord of the worlds, and I love that my deeds be raised while I am fasting.
